title: Confirm a work item claim before running it
summary: Confirms, immediately before an item is run, that the claim is still held and its lease is still live. A claim is a lease on running an item and the window can pass between claiming and starting, so an item whose window passed is claimable again; accepting it is what stops the same work from running on two machines. Only a success authorizes running the item. A refusal is not a completion: the worker must not run it and must not report a result.

parameters.name: worker_id
parameters.description: Worker identity that owns the claim.

response.name: ok
response.description: True when the claim was confirmed and the item may be run.

title: Claim work item
summary: Self-hosted sandbox workers poll this endpoint to claim pending tool-execution work.

response.name: item
response.description: Claimed work item, or null when no work is pending.

title: Renew work item claim
summary: Renews the claim lease on a work item this worker still holds, so an item that outlives the lease window is not reclaimed and handed to another worker while it is still running.

parameters.name: worker_id
parameters.description: Worker identity that owns the claim.

response.name: ok
response.description: True when the lease was renewed.

title: Complete work item
summary: Self-hosted sandbox workers report completion, failure, and output for a claimed work item.

parameters.name: worker_id
parameters.description: Worker identity that owns the claim.

parameters.name: failed
parameters.description: True when the work item failed.

title: List environment worker keys
summary: Lists a self-hosted environment's worker keys with key_prefix, status, and last-seen metadata. The secret is never listed.

response.name: data
response.description: Worker keys, each carrying key_prefix rather than the secret.

title: Issue environment worker key
summary: Issues a worker key and returns the raw secret exactly once. Only the SHA-256 hash is stored, so the secret can never be read back.

response.name: secret_key
response.description: Raw secret, returned only by this response.

response.name: key_prefix
response.description: Non-secret prefix shown by every later response.

title: Revoke environment worker key
summary: Revokes a worker key. A claim presenting a revoked key is refused before any work item changes hands.

response.name: key
response.description: The revoked key, carrying key_prefix and status.

title: List environment work items
summary: Inspects recent self-hosted work items for one environment together with that environment's status counts. An environment with no configured work queue is refused rather than answered with an empty page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional page size. An unusable value falls back to the queue default, and the queue clamps the result to at most 200.

response.name: data
response.description: Recent work items for this environment, newest first, in the same shape a worker receives from the claim route.

response.name: counts
response.description: Work item counts per status for this environment.
